note: Both sets capture the same core facts from the page — telescope/mirror diameters, focal length, and science instrument counts for HabEx, LUVOIR-A, LUVOIR-B, Lynx and Origins — with correct values, units and supporting quotes. Set A states each fact once and is complete. Set B is equally accurate but restates four facts under two entity names (Lynx mirror assembly diameter, Origins telescope diameter, LUVOIR-A telescope diameter, LUVOIR-B telescope diameter), adding redundancy without new information. Neither set is wrong on any value, so the cleaner, non-duplicated Set A is preferable.
remarks: Both sets omit the 'flying in formation' condition attached to the HabEx 52 m starshade; minor but a needed condition for that claim. Otherwise the page's engineering facts are fully covered by both.
